To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have presented version 3.2 of CalcHEP software which is designed for evaluation of high energy physics processes at parton and hadron level.

we have: (i) implemented a new version of the CalcHEp package which is able to calculate the production and decay of the new physics states at the LHC, (ii) developed new models which can describe the data of the Higgs and top-quark sectors, (iii) developed new tools to study the phenomenology of the models, and (iv) developed new models to describe the data of dark matter experiments.

CalcHEP  3.4 has the ability to: - calculate cross sections, decay widths and other physical quantities of processes with a high level automation; - simulate parton level events for processes with many final state particles; - provide an interface with MadGraph5_aMC@NLO for matching with NLO calculations; - provide an easy interface with FeynRules for model building; - provide a graphical user interface; - allow the use of CalcHEP with the batch interface.

the development of a software package for the simulation of particle physics processes at the LHC and future colliders.

CalcHEP is a very powerful, flexible and user-friendly tool for the study and simulation of high-energy collider physics within and well beyond the Standard Model.
